FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND fiscal_period <= 3
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period

FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

FROM ref_fiscal_calendar

SELECT COUNT(*) as line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as receipt_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 1)
  AND sale_date <= (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 3)

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(period_start_date) AS period_start,
    MAX(period_end_date) AS period_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2, 3)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS total_returns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS net_sales,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.receipt_id = r.sales_line_id AND f.sale_date = r.return_date
CROSS JOIN period_dates pd
WHERE f.sale_date >= pd.period_start AND f.sale_date <= pd.period_end

  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar

)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.channel_name, CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'ST' THEN 'Store' WHEN f.channel_code = 'WB' THEN 'Web' END) AS channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
CROSS JOIN period_dates pd
WHERE f.sale_date >= pd.period_start AND f.sale_date <= pd.period_end
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel

),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales,
    SUM(receipts) AS total_receipts
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, period_dates pd
  WHERE business_date >= pd.period_start AND business_date <= pd.period_end
)
SELECT 
  total_net_sales,
  total_receipts,
  ROUND(total_net_sales / total_receipts, 2) AS atv_from_report
FROM daily_totals
